script.name: Copy Steam client library
script.code:
chmod +x Unturned_Headless.x86_64 2>/dev/null
mkdir -p .steam/sdk64
if [ -f linux64/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/steamclient.so; fi
